cases.scope: Diagnostic IRQ byte pump with block-completion signal
Diagnostic IRQ byte pump with block-completion signal

irq_pump_contract: Busy root without Exec calls during transfer, six parked bystanders, no timed sleepers or other READY peers; one worker waits for block completion
burst3_timing_note: Injected long I=1 hardware wait deliberately distorts full-drain time; normal totals use burst2. Burst3 supplies correctness and per-target transaction evidence only.

post_scaling.interpretation: No per-bystander loop in post or one-target drain; total all-target draining is O(k).

reservation_repack.scope: Explicit upper reservation bank ownership preserves all qualified emitted images byte-for-byte
